ticket.summary: Repeat low pressure at master shower (both hot and cold, other fixtures normal) on older Delta valve — confirmed weak flow with showerhead removed, so cartridge/pressure-balance spool is the cause; previously serviced in March.
mitigation_advice: Removed showerhead and ran the valve into a bucket to isolate head vs. valve — flow still weak, confirming the cartridge rather than a clogged head/screen
Confirmed both hot and cold are affected and other fixtures are normal, ruling out a whole-house supply or water heater issue
No temporary fix attempted tonight; advised to leave the valve as-is until the tech arrives

quote_lines.description: Delta shower cartridge replacement, parts + labor (bring rebuild kit: seats/springs, O-rings)

ticket.customer_message: You're booked, Priya — Tuesday Sep 1, 1–3pm. The tech will bring Delta cartridges and a rebuild kit so it gets sorted in one visit, and we've flagged your March ticket so they know this is a repeat and will check for what's chewing up the cartridge (debris, worn seats/springs) rather than just swapping it. Quote is $245 all-in for the cartridge repair; anything beyond that gets your approval first. Text this number if anything changes — see you tomorrow afternoon!
